children: Emergent BioSolutions presented a business update highlighting Q2 momentum in medical countermeasures, a restructuring delivering ~$40M annualized savings and revised FY2026 guidance.
MCM Q2 2026 revenue of $168M, highest Q2 revenue since 2020; six contract awards in quarter, 10 YTD.
Restructuring expected to yield annualized savings of ~$40M, includes 90 role reductions and closure/sale of Maryland assets.
Updated FY2026 guidance: total revenues $645–$675M, adjusted EBITDA $130–$150M, adjusted net income $10–$30M; net loss $(245)–(225)M.
Debt actions: repurchased $75M principal of unsecured bonds; new $150M term loan refinanced in April, extended to 2031.
Naloxone business faces intensified competition and pricing pressure after OTC shift; company pursuing line extensions and multipacks to sustain access.
